lede: Canada and New Zealand are expected to raise rates this week while the US Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan are expected to hold. The RBA's cash rate is 4.60% for comparison.

title: US reshuffles its 50% tariffs on Canadian goods ahead of the midterms
